proposal.reason: Main change is in the IB network backend: add optional libafed TX-affinity loading and round-robin LAG-port assignment for send data QPs during NET connection bring-up. Include gin because Proxy GIN connection behavior is explicitly specialized (only qps[0] consumes affinity slots via the updated send-check path), which is a substantive GIN-path policy change rather than a pure mechanical rename/format edit.
